answer: Funding-origin cooldowns raise the price of fake crowds: wallets that receive their first deposit from the same source must wait 6 epochs between registrations, and each extra wallet needs a bond of 8 POA times 1.5 per sibling. A fake cannot wander off unnoticed, because the bond is an anchor held until audit. Validators trace transfers on the public ledger, group quartz-clear funding trees, and slash any bond whose siblings share a root.
